description: This PHP file defines the class AOR_ReportsViewDetail which extends ViewDetail, and includes methods for rendering detailed report views, fetching report parameters, and handling UI interactions such as resizing graphs. It is part of the SuiteCRM module for report detail views.

classes.name: AOR_ReportsViewDetail
classes.description: A class extending ViewDetail to display detailed report information including parameters, charts, and UI interactions.

methods.name: getReportParameters
methods.description: Fetches and constructs report parameters based on linked conditions and user settings.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Prepares data for display, assigns content to template variables, loads language files, generates report content and charts, and adds UI scripts.
